name: wikibooklm

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,worker,frontend -c blue,yellow,magenta "pnpm --filter backend dev" "pnpm --filter backend dev:worker" "pnpm --filter frontend dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter backend build && pnpm --filter frontend build

pnpmOverridesNote: prisma's bundled studio pulls @types/react 19 into the workspace, and @types/react-dom 18 then resolves against it — which makes every react-router element fail to type-check in the SPA. The app is React 18; the overrides below pin the types to match it.
